title: The Teal Titan of Gold's on 5th
creativeBrief: Marcus takes three dry scoops of an experimental pre-workout. His skin turns vivid teal and his physique escalates continuously into a monumental, balanced bodybuilder form. The gym responds with understated reverence. He never stops posing.

continuityLocks.skinColor: saturated blue-green teal; not emerald or cyan
continuityLocks.identity: preserve verified adult face, head shape, hair and distinguishing features
continuityLocks.pecs: bilateral pectoral growth stays balanced; width, projection and thickness increase together
continuityLocks.anatomy: rounded connected muscle groups; continuous deltoid-pectoral-arm and torso transitions
continuityLocks.scale: height and limb length increase with muscular mass; retain joints and grounded stance
continuityLocks.surface: living skin, subtle tonal variation, soft natural highlights; no stone, rubber, metallic gloss or gritty overlays
continuityLocks.wardrobe: fabric responds to increasing volume and tension; retain a readable chest silhouette
continuityLocks.finalState: monumental new baseline; pose held through the final frames
